final_coverage_assessment: Iteration 1 surfaced strong candidate sources across international organizations (WHO, UNICEF, ECDC, CDC) and one INRB/ReliefWeb French-language sitrep. The UNICEF SitRep (20 Aug–1 Sep 2024) snippet contains a partial aggregate figure (20,015 suspected cases, 632 deaths as of week 35) but this is a year-to-date cumulative figure, not an August-only monthly total. The ReliefWeb sitrep No. 025 (29 Aug 2024) is the most directly relevant national source but only appeared as a title/URL — no numeric content was confirmed. WHO DON 2024-DON522 covers the DRC outbreak context but its snippet does not contain August 2024 case counts. The PMC article on Kokolo health zone (Kinshasa) covers August–November 2024 and could provide locality-level data. Africa CDC was not represented in the top results despite being a primary source for weekly African Mpox data. WHO AFRO external situation reports for August 2024 (sitrep nos. covering epi weeks 31–35) were not directly surfaced. Coverage is promising but incomplete for the target fields.
final_trustworthiness_assessment: High-trust sources identified: WHO DON (who.int), UNICEF SitRep (unicef.org), ReliefWeb-hosted DRC sitrep No. 025 (reliefweb.int, sourced from DRC Ministry of Health/INRB), ECDC (ecdc.europa.eu), INRB (inrb.cd), CDC HAN (cdc.gov), PMC peer-reviewed article (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov). Medium-trust: MSF/Doctors Without Borders (operational context, not primary surveillance data), NETEC (secondary summary). Low-trust: facebook.com posts (not usable as primary evidence). The facebook.com results should be excluded from evidence extraction. The ReliefWeb sitrep No. 025 and INRB result are the highest-priority targets for August 2024 subnational data.
